sloka: कैकेय्या न वयम् राज्ये भृतका निवसेमहि ।जीवन्त्या जातु जीवन्त्यः पुत्रैः अपि शपामहे ॥२-४८-२३॥
transliteration: kaikeyyā na vayam rājye bhṛtakā nivasemahi ।jīvantyā jātu jīvantyaḥ putraiḥ api śapāmahe ॥2-48-23॥

translations.english: We swear on our sons that as long as Kaikeyi lives, or we live, we will never stay in her kingdom as servants.
